title: Data repository manifest
description: The entry point of the data repository. Written by the tracker, never by the coach. It is an inventory, not an interpretation: it says what exists, over which dates, and how to tell whether a file has changed. Conclusions such as mode, retention debt or topic health are deliberately absent, because planning from a summary means planning without the evidence behind it.

generatedFor.description: The tracker savedAt this manifest describes. Deliberately not the time of generation, so regenerating unchanged data produces an identical file.

trackerFingerprint.description: Hash of the tracker's facts in canonical form, not of its bytes. Key and array order shift whenever the browser rehydrates, and a fingerprint that moved with them would report unchanged data as new.

contracts.description: Where the rules live. codeCommit pins the version of the policy and schema that were in force.

eligibleColdTests.description: Graded attempts that are cold, unaided and not a same-day repeat. Zero here means retention debt is not calculable at all, which is the one number worth knowing before fetching anything.

shards.description: One entry per calendar month, in ascending order. Read the entries covering the window you need and fetch only those files.

fingerprint.description: Changes only when the month's facts change, so a reader holding this month can skip fetching it.

decision.description: The current plan. Overwritten on every revision.

index.description: Summaries of every published assessment, newest first, with the dates each covers. Read this for prior advice rather than walking commits.

assessments.description: Directory of archived assessments, addressable by id.
